note: This file is a pure configuration file (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines training/inference hyperparameters for ImVoxelNet 3D object detection on ScanNet using MMDetection3D.
run_training: run the ImVoxelNet 3D object detection training on ScanNet using this config file
review_model_config: review the ImVoxelNet model configuration with ResNet50 backbone and FPN neck for ScanNet
summarize_train_pipeline: summarize the training data pipeline with 20 multi-view images and random shift augmentation
review_test_pipeline: review the test data pipeline with 50 multi-view images for ScanNet evaluation
review_optimizer_config: review the AdamW optimizer config with learning rate 0.0001 and backbone lr multiplier 0.1
